platform: Arch Linux / Hyprland (including compatible Omarchy Quattro)

core.name: Quickshell
core.description: QML desktop shell runtime (RC5 developed against 0.3.1).

core.name: Hyprland
core.description: Wayland compositor, monitor and workspace integration.

core.name: Python 3
core.description: RusticQ integration, updates and diagnostics helpers.

core.name: Material Symbols
core.description: System fallback for bar, menu and settings glyphs.

optional.name: NetworkManager
optional.description: Wi-Fi and Ethernet status and controls; service must be running.

optional.name: QR Encode
optional.description: Secure Wi-Fi sharing QR from Advanced Wi-Fi. Optional; alternatively install python-qrcode.

optional.name: Bluetooth service
optional.description: Bluetooth hardware backend; bluetooth.service must be running.

optional.name: Bluetooth tools
optional.description: Bluetooth CLI compatibility tools.

optional.name: UPower
optional.description: Battery/power state; mainly for portable devices.

optional.name: PipeWire
optional.description: Audio server for volume and media components.

optional.name: WirePlumber
optional.description: PipeWire audio session manager.

optional.name: Playerctl
optional.description: Media controls for compatible players.

optional.name: Brightnessctl
optional.description: Brightness control on supported hardware.

optional.name: Grim
optional.description: Wayland screenshot capture.

optional.name: Slurp
optional.description: Select screen or region for capture/recording.

optional.name: WF Recorder
optional.description: Wayland screen recording.

optional.name: Wayland clipboard
optional.description: Clipboard interaction from optional actions.

optional.name: XDG utilities
optional.description: Open files and folders from bar menus.

optional.name: Pacman contrib
optional.description: Safe checkupdates list for Arch Updater.

optional.name: PolicyKit
optional.description: Polkit utilities for privileged updates; a session agent may also be required.

optional.name: Hyprsunset
optional.description: Night light quick mode.

optional.name: Btop
optional.description: External process monitor from the Shell menu.

optional.name: JQ
optional.description: Compatibility with the legacy iwctl Wi-Fi helper.

optional.name: Lm-sensors
optional.description: Additional system temperature readings.

optional.name: Qt Multimedia
optional.description: Additional audio/video Qt multimedia integration.

optional.name: Screen Color Picker
optional.description: Pick HEX screen color from the launcher (no network upload).

optional.name: Tesseract OCR
optional.description: Local-only screenshot OCR. Also requires grim, slurp and wl-clipboard.

optional.name: Desktop notifications
optional.description: Optional success/failure notifications for screen capture tools.

optional.name: Flatpak
optional.description: Search and install sandboxed applications in GUI; add Flathub remote first.

optional.name: Hyprlock
optional.description: Optional fallback locker. RusticQ Native Lock uses Quickshell WlSessionLock/PAM instead.

optional.name: Swaybg Low Memory
optional.description: Low-memory static wallpaper backend; installed on request from Integration.
